# Measurement sheet

Each reading is taken INDEPENDENTLY: lay the tape again, do not copy the first number. The
point of two readings is their spread, and two copies of one reading have a spread of zero and
tell you nothing. Readings that disagree by more than the tolerance block the cut.

Conventions, from `data/garments/*/record.json`: waist, thigh and leg opening are FULL
CIRCUMFERENCES (measured flat and doubled). Rise is from the crotch seam to the top of the
waistband along the fly. Inseam is crotch seam to hem along the inside leg. Thigh is 2.5 cm
below the crotch.

## Post-wash, the same dimensions again

Shrinkage is the difference between two measurements, so the after-wash set is taken the same
way, twice each, by the same method. A dimension measured carefully before and casually after
produces a shrinkage figure that is mostly the change in method.
